verdict.rationale: Cognee documents a unified `.forget` operation supporting single item deletion, full dataset deletion (graph+vector data), and full account cleanup, and this was validated at runtime (cognee-cli forget teardown). Combined with dataset-scoped permissions/isolation, this gives clear user control over retention and deletion. Missing for 10: no explicit data-retention policy/TTL settings, no independent third-party audit of deletion completeness, and no evidence of cloud-side deletion guarantees beyond local/self-hosted runs.
